description: This file defines the CreateEmailCommandHandler class, which handles 'CREATE' actions for EMAIL entities within the campaign email infrastructure. It listens for commands, processes them by invoking the EmailWritePlatformService, and is annotated as a Spring Service with command type metadata.

classes.name: CreateEmailCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring Service that handles 'CREATE' commands for email entities by delegating command processing to the EmailWritePlatformService.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes a JSON command for creating an email by calling the create method on the email write platform service.
